title: Read where your data lives. Turn it into answers you can trust.

steps.title: Read
steps.body: Ingest quality certificates, spec sheets, and incoming requests from PDF, Excel, email, and your ERP.

steps.title: Check
steps.body: Match and compare across raw-material, internal, and customer requirements.

steps.title: Surface
steps.body: Surface the matches, gaps, and recommendations to your team — read-only insight, never written back to your ERP.
